locale.name: package.description
locale.en: The menu plugin provides various menu controls.

locale.name: menu.settings.showMenuDelay.desc
locale.en: Specify this value in milliseconds. 250 means that the submenu appears after hovering over the menu item for 1/4 of a second. If you set 0, the submenu is displayed immediately.

locale.name: menu.settings.type.desc
locale.en: Defines the default for the dropdown submenus in the MegaMenu. The selection affects the child entries of each menu item; icons, images and descriptions are displayed for further subpages depending on the menu type.

locale.name: menu.settings.type.site.desc
locale.en: Overrides the project setting for the dropdown submenu below this page. "Use project default" uses the project setting.

locale.name: menu.settings.IconsDescription
locale.en: MegaMenu - Sub pages with Icons, Images and Descriptions

locale.name: menu.settings.Simple
locale.en: MegaMenu - Simple list with sub pages

locale.name: mobileMenu.settings.breakPoint
locale.en: Use mobile menu up to this width

locale.name: mobileMenu.settings.breakPoint.desc
locale.en: Maximum window width at which the mobile menu is displayed (default value is 767). This value is specified in pixels.

locale.name: mobileMenu.standard.settings.collapseSubmenu.desc
locale.en: For large menus it is recommended to activate the option. This way only the specified depth of the navigation will be visible (with setting "1" only the first level of the navigation). You can open the submenu items by tapping on the arrow.

locale.name: mobileMenu.standard.settings.showLevel.desc
locale.en: The option specifies how many levels of the navigation will be visible initially. If the option "1" is selected, only the first level will be visible, the rest will be collapsed.

locale.name: mobileMenu.slideoutAdvanced.settings.desc
locale.en: This menu shows only one menu level at a time. You can navigate back and forth between the levels by tapping the arrows. Additionally, the description of the pages can be displayed (if available).

locale.name: mobileMenu.slideoutAdvanced.settings.shortDesc.desc
locale.en: This option has no influence when using the individual menu (so called "Independent Menu").

locale.name: menu.control.sidebarDropDownMenu.description
locale.en: Displays a multi-level navigation as a sidebar menu. Alternatively, an independent menu can be used instead of the page structure.

locale.name: menu.control.sidebarDropDownMenu.setting.menuId.desc
locale.en: Select an independent menu. If a menu ID is set, this menu is used instead of the page structure.

locale.name: menu.control.sidebarDropDownMenu.setting.onlyFirstLevelIcons
locale.en: Show icons only on first level

locale.name: menu.control.sidebarDropDownMenu.setting.showAllChildren
locale.en: Also show pages that do not have the property Show in navigation.

locale.name: menu.control.urlList.description
locale.en: Simple page list that you can use perfectly in the footer. This control will build only the first level of the subpages.

locale.name: menu.control.urlList.setting.startId.desc
locale.en: Select the parent site. Notice: if "Menu ID" is selected, this option has no effect.

locale.name: menu.control.urlList.setting.icon.desc
locale.en: When an icon is selected, it is displayed in front of the link. Only FontAwesome icons are supported. Tip! In the selection window you can filter by right if you want to use an arrow-style icon.

locale.name: menu.control.urlList.setting.resetLinkColor.desc
locale.en: If the option is active, the link has the same color as the page content. This option does not affect the mouse-over effect. Caution! The template you are using can overwrite this setting.

locale.name: menu.control.OnePageNav.description
locale.en: Navigation for one page. The menu items scroll to the corresponding sections on the home page.

locale.name: menu.control.OnePageNav.entries.link
locale.en:
Page link or CSS selector.
Page link: the URL must be valid.
CSS selector: Element to scroll to. E.g. .css-class, #elementId

locale.name: control.navTabsVertical.description
locale.en: Vertical menu items. The content is next to the menu items.

locale.name: control.verticalTabSwitcher.description
locale.en: Vertical menu items. The content is next to the menu items.

locale.name: control.navTabsVertical.entries.delete.title
locale.en: Do you really want to remove this entry?

locale.name: permission.quiqqer.menu.mcp.canUse
locale.en: Can use the menu MCP tools

locale.name: control.tabs.description
locale.en: This brick allows you to generate a tabbed interface with different content. Choose your own icons and layout for the tabs. Place not only texts but also images in the content.

locale.name: control.tabs.autoPlay.desc
locale.en: Enables automatic tab switching. When enabled, the slider advances to the next tab automatically after the configured interval.

locale.name: control.tabs.autoPlay.interval.desc
locale.en: Time in milliseconds before automatically switching to the next tab.

locale.name: control.tabs.autoPlay.pauseOnHover.desc
locale.en: Temporarily pauses autoplay while the mouse pointer is over the entire tabs control. The autoplay setting itself remains active and continues after leaving the control.

locale.name: control.tabs.autoPlay.progress.indicator.desc
locale.en: Selects the visualization for the autoplay timer progress.

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.desc
locale.en: Determines how the transitions between the tabs are animated.

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.scaleToSmallScaleFromLarge
locale.en: Zoom: hide to small / show from large

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.scaleToSmallScaleFromSmall
locale.en: Zoom: hide to small / show from small

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.scaleToLargeScaleFromLarge
locale.en: Zoom: hide to large / show from large

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.scaleToLargeScaleFromSmall
locale.en: Zoom: hide to large / show from small

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.slideOutToRightSlideInFromLeft
locale.en: Slide: hide to right / show from left

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.slideOutToRightSlideInFromRight
locale.en: Slide: hide to right / show from right

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.slideOutToLeftSlideInFromRight
locale.en: Slide: hide to left / show from right

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.slideOutToLeftSlideInFromLeft
locale.en: Slide: hide to left / show from left

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.slideOutToBottomSlideInFromBottom
locale.en: Slide: hide to bottom / show from bottom

locale.name: control.tabs.animation.slideOutToBottomSlideInFromTop
locale.en: Slide: hide to bottom / show from top

locale.name: control.tabs.navImgHeight.desc
locale.en: This value determines how big the icons will be in the tab navigation (in pixels). Default value is 20.

locale.name: control.tabs.navStyle.onlyImg
locale.en: Only the icon. Title is hidden.

locale.name: control.tabs.navWrapText.noWrap
locale.en: The title will not be wrapped

locale.name: control.tabs.navFillSpace.desc
locale.en: If enabled, the navigation entries are stretched so that the entire available area is used.

locale.name: control.tabs.navCenter.desc
locale.en: If enabled, the navigation entries are centered. If the "Use full width" option is active, this setting has no effect.

locale.name: control.tabs.contentImgMinWidth.desc
locale.en: Minimum image width in pixels. Please do not use large values. Recommended is 100px to 600px. Default value is 200px.

locale.name: control.tabs.contentImgMaxWidth.desc
locale.en: Maximum image width in pixels. Please do not use large values. Recommended is 200px to 600px. Default value is 400px.

locale.name: control.tabs.contentTextWidth.desc
locale.en: Maximum text width in pixels. Please do not use large values. Recommended is 200px to 1000px. Default value is 600px.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.desc
locale.en: Place a sub-navigation on your page. This allows you to scroll within the page or link to other subpages.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.description
locale.en: Place a sub-navigation on your page. This allows you to scroll within the page or link to other subpages.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.startId.desc
locale.en: Select the parent site. Notice: if "Menu ID" is selected, this option has no effect.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.template.box-imageTop
locale.en: Box: Image or icon above the text

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.template.box-imageOverlay
locale.en: Box: Text overlaid on the image (not suitable if icons are set as images)

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.controlBgColor.desc
locale.en: The selected color is applied behind the menu.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.linkColor.desc
locale.en: Sets the color of the link. If no color is selected, the color is inherited (usually text color).

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.linkColorHover.desc
locale.en: This color is used when you move the mouse over the link.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.showImages.desc
locale.en: If the menu entries have images or icons set, these are displayed (except in template "List: simple").

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageFitMode.desc
locale.en: This setting only affects images, not icons.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageFitMode.fill
locale.en: Fill: Fill the entire area - image can be distorted

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageFitMode.contain
locale.en: Contain: Image is resized to fit in the available space

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageFitMode.cover
locale.en: Cover: Fill entire area - image can be cut off

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageFitMode.none
locale.en: None: the image retains its original size

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageFitMode.scale-down
locale.en: Scale down: the image may be reduced in size.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.imageContainerHeight.desc
locale.en: You can use any valid CSS value, including the clamp() function. If no value is set, the container becomes square.

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.boxBgColor.desc
locale.en: This setting only works with the templates "Box: Image or icon above the text" and "Box: Text overlaid on the image (not suitable if icons are set as images)".

locale.name: bricks.submenu.settings.boxWidth.desc
locale.en: You can use any valid CSS value, including the clamp() function. This setting only works with the templates "Box: Image or icon above the text" and "Box: Text overlaid on the image (not suitable if icons are set as images)".

locale.name: item.anchor.short
locale.en: With this menu type it is possible to select an internal QUIQQER page and define an anchor.

locale.name: item.custom.short
locale.en: Customisation of the menu item. You can select a page, call up a customised JavaScript function and much more.

locale.name: item.site.title
locale.en: Menu entry: To an internal page from a project

locale.name: item.site.short
locale.en: Allows selection of an internal QUIQQER page.

locale.name: item.url.short
locale.en: It is possible to select both an internal QUIQQER page and a link to an external page.

locale.name: menu.saved.successfully
locale.en: The menu has been saved successfully.

locale.name: floatingMenu.settings.desc
locale.en: A "Floating menu" is a menu that is superimposed over the content of the page and often "floats" or remains fixed in a certain position, even when scrolling down. This menu can be placed at the edge of the screen or in a corner, for example, and remains visible so that the user can access it quickly at any time.

locale.name: floatingMenu.settings.menuId.desc
locale.en: If a menu is selected here, it is automatically activated and visible to users on the page. A menu must first be created under Settings → Menu management. If you want to deactivate the floating menu, simply remove the selected menu by clicking on the X button.

locale.name: floatingMenu.settings.showLangSwitch.desc
locale.en: If the project is multilingual, you can use this option to enable language switching.

locale.name: floatingMenu.settings.toggleButton.desc
locale.en: The toggle button shows and hides the floating navigation. This option allows you to specify when it is displayed or if it remains completely hidden.

locale.name: floatingMenu.settings.toggleButton.always
locale.en: Show on mobile and on desktop

locale.name: deletion.window.text
locale.en: Do you really want to delete the following menus?

locale.name: deletion.window.information
locale.en: The following menus are deleted irrevocably: [list]

locale.name: tpl.relDescription
locale.en: The rel attribute specifies the relationship between the current document and the linked document.

locale.name: tpl.shortDesc
locale.en: Short text displayed under the link. This property is not used in all menu types (supported, for example, by "MegaMenu - Simple list with sub pages").

locale.name: tpl.clickDescription
locale.en: Add here the function name of the JavaScript function which should be called on click. If you want to execute your own function on click, you can use the custom.js of your project.

locale.name: tpl.rel.alternate
locale.en: alternate - Provides a link to an alternate representation of the document (i.e. print page, translated or mirror)

locale.name: tpl.rel.author
locale.en: author - Provides a link to the author of the document

locale.name: tpl.rel.bookmark
locale.en: bookmark - Permanent URL used for bookmarking

locale.name: tpl.rel.external
locale.en: external - Indicates that the referenced document is not part of the same site as the current document

locale.name: tpl.rel.help
locale.en: help - Provides a link to a help document

locale.name: tpl.rel.license
locale.en: license - Provides a link to licensing information for the document

locale.name: tpl.rel.next
locale.en: next - Provides a link to the next document in the series

locale.name: tpl.rel.nofollow
locale.en: nofollow - is used by Google, to specify that the Google search spider should not follow that link

locale.name: tpl.rel.noopener
locale.en: noopener - Requires that any browsing context created by following the hyperlink must not have an opener browsing context

locale.name: tpl.rel.noreferrer
locale.en: noreferrer - Makes the referrer unknown. No referer header will be included when the user clicks the hyperlink

locale.name: tpl.rel.prev
locale.en: prev - The previous document in a selection

locale.name: tpl.rel.search
locale.en: search - Links to a search tool for the document

locale.name: tpl.rel.tag
locale.en: tag - A tag (keyword) for the current document

locale.name: message.menu.publish.successful
locale.en: The menu has been successfully published.

locale.name: window.deleteItem.information
locale.en: Do you really want to delete the menu entry [entry]? This entry will be deleted irrevocably and cannot be restored.

locale.name: quiqqer.menu.independent.changeItemType.message
locale.en: Change the type of the menu item. Note that some data can no longer be used as a result.

locale.name: tpl.statusDescription
locale.en: Enables (checked) or disables (unchecked) the item. If deactivated, the menu entry is not displayed in the menu

locale.name: create.window.text
locale.en: Please specify the type (type of entry), which the new entry should get. The type can be changed at any time.

locale.name: quiqqer.menu.select.win.content
locale.en: Please select a menu you want to assign.
